content: Each 100 mL of 10% LMD (dextran 40) in 5% dextrose injection contains 10 grams of dextran 40 and 5 grams of dextrose hydrous dissolved in water for injection. The total osmolar concentration of this solution is 255 mOsmol/L (calculated). A separate solution of 0.9% sodium chloride in water for injection has a total osmolar concentration of 310 mOsmol/L (calculated). This solution may contain sodium hydroxide and/or hydrochloric acid for pH adjustment. The electrolyte concentration per liter in this solution is as follows: sodium (Na⁺) 154 mEq and chloride (Cl⁻) 154 mEq, excluding ions added for pH adjustment. These solutions do not contain any bacteriostatic agents, antimicrobial agents, or added buffers (except for pH adjustment) and are intended for single-dose injection only. If smaller doses are required, any unused portion of the solution must be discarded. The 0.9% sodium chloride injection serves as a fluid and electrolyte replenisher. Dextran 40 is a linear glucose polymer (polysaccharide) chemically designated as (C₆H₁₀O₅)n. Its structural formula consists of repeating glucose units. Dextrose, USP, is chemically designated as D-glucose monohydrate (C₆H₁₂O₆·H₂O), a hexose sugar that is freely soluble in water. Sodium chloride, USP, is chemically designated as NaCl, a white crystalline powder that is freely soluble in water. Water for injection, USP, is chemically designated as H₂O. The flexible plastic container used for these solutions is made from a specially formulated polyvinyl chloride. Water can permeate from inside the container into the overwrap, but not in amounts sufficient to significantly affect the solution. Additionally, small amounts of certain chemical components of the plastic may leach into the solution over time, but this occurs in very small quantities and only before the expiration date. The safety of the plastic has been confirmed through animal testing in accordance with USP biological standards for plastic containers. How Supplied The 10% dextran 40 in 5% dextrose injection (Dextran 40 in Dextrose Injection, USP) is supplied in a 500 mL single-dose flexible container (NDC 0409-7418-03). The 0.9% sodium chloride injection (Dextran 40 in Sodium Chloride Injection, USP) is supplied in a 500 mL single-dose flexible container (NDC 0409-7419-03). Storage Store at 20 to 25°C (68 to 77°F). Protect from freezing. Patient Counseling Information There is limited information available regarding patient counseling information for dextran in the drug label. Precautions with Alcohol The interaction between alcohol and dextran has not been established. Patients should consult their doctor regarding the effects of consuming alcohol while taking this medication.
